defaultLongView: Clear decisions, durable materials and a place that can remain useful over time.

centro-corporativo-sabana.longView: An office center with amenities and sustainability goals, including the LEED Gold certification described in the official portfolio.
centro-corporativo-sabana.statement: The official portfolio describes Centro Corporativo La Sabana as an 18-level office building with three parking basements, office areas of 2,800 m² per floor and amenities including a gym, sports areas, spa, viewpoints, terraces and balconies.
centro-corporativo-sabana.summary: A corporate office center in Sabana Sur, described by the official portfolio as an 18-level building with three parking basements.

el-cafetal.longView: Seven office buildings, gardens, parking and access roads form the corporate setting described in the official portfolio.
el-cafetal.statement: The official portfolio describes seven eco-friendly office buildings, extensive gardens, 2,100 parking spaces and key access roads serving a corporate center with 5,600 employees.
el-cafetal.summary: A corporate center in Belén, Heredia, formed by seven office towers with gardens, parking and access roads

santa-ana-country-club.longView: A private club organized around sports, fitness, dining and social connection, as described by the official portfolio.
santa-ana-country-club.statement: The official portfolio describes Santa Ana Country Club as an eight-hectare social and sports club with gastronomic, aquatic, racquet sports, fitness and social spaces.
santa-ana-country-club.summary: A social and sports club on an eight-hectare site in Pozos de Santa Ana, with dining, aquatic, racquet, fitness and social amenities.

universidad-latina.longView: An educational and recreational campus organized for the daily experience of students, as described in the official portfolio.
universidad-latina.statement: The official portfolio describes a 15,000 m², five-level building that integrates educational and recreational infrastructure for private higher education.
universidad-latina.summary: An educational campus in Heredia integrating classrooms, workshops, laboratories, library, administrative offices and a food court.

waldorf-astoria.longView: A hospitality project framed by the natural setting and destination experience described in the official portfolio.
waldorf-astoria.statement: Garnier's official portfolio describes the Waldorf Astoria Hotel Project at Playa Penca, Punta Cacique, with 188 rooms and around 30 residences.
waldorf-astoria.summary: A hospitality project at Playa Penca, Punta Cacique, Guanacaste, planned around a hotel and residences.

zona-franca-la-lima.longView: A business and infrastructure platform for advanced manufacturing, life sciences, logistics and related services.
zona-franca-la-lima.statement: The official portfolio describes La Lima as a 79-hectare mixed-commercial development with a technological profile for advanced manufacturing, life sciences, logistics centers and supplier and service companies.
zona-franca-la-lima.summary: A free zone and industrial park in La Lima, Cartago, covering 79 hectares for advanced manufacturing, life sciences, logistics and related services.
